title: Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang's Award-Winning “Las Culturistas" from iHeartMedia and Will Ferrell's Big Money Players to Stream on Disney+ and Hulu Beginning November 18
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
***Hosted by Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang, the Hit Pop Culture Podcast Will Stream New Video Episodes Weekly on Both Platforms***


***Enjoy “Las Culturistas with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang” now***[HERE](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-las-culturistas-with-matt-31090140/)


**NEW YORK — October 15, 2026 —** iHeartMedia and Will Ferrell's Big Money Players Podcast Network (BMP) today announced that its award-winning pop culture podcast, “[Las Culturistas with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-las-culturistas-with-matt-31090140/) ,” will stream on[Disney+](https://www.disneyplus.com/) and[Hulu](https://www.hulu.com/welcome) beginning November 18, with new video podcast episodes weekly. The addition further expands[iHeartPodcasts’ growing video lineup on Disney+ and Hulu](https://www.iheartmedia.com/pressrelease/disney-hulu-and-iheartmedia-announce-video-podcast-deal-beginning-hit-iheartpodcasts-hey) , giving fans more ways to enjoy and connect with their favorite shows across platforms.


Launched in March 2016, “Las Culturistas with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang” has become a podcasting mainstay, known for Matt and Bowen’s unfiltered takes and candid conversations with some of the biggest names in entertainment about the latest pop-culture moments and experiences. Featuring popular segments like “I Don’t Think So, Honey,” the show has welcomed guests including Mariah Carey, Michelle Obama, Lady Gaga, Reese Witherspoon, Ariana Grande, Charli XCX, Chappell Roan and Nicole Kidman. The show has earned numerous accolades, including Podcast of the Year at the 2023 and 2025 iHeartRadio Podcast Awards, as well as comedy podcast wins from the GLAAD Media Awards and the Ambies.


“Las Culturistas with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang” will join a growing library of iHeartPodcasts currently streaming on Disney+ and Hulu, including “[Hey Jonas!](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-19804ba3-cd07-4aa9-a018-7be1e4fc0af4) ,” “[Pod Meets World](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-ea75b7fe-5d0d-42f2-9bdf-2eaaeec9eb72) ,” “[Fake Doctors, Real Friends](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-918f89e7-87da-40e0-b2f6-ecf9fd43f9f6) ,” “[StraightioLab](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-8f1a84b0-1153-4ae3-a55a-a5bf73aad347) ” and BMP’s “[Thanks Dad with Ego Nwodim](https://www.disneyplus.com/browse/entity-7c58b627-39ec-450a-ae26-9751b5409b39) ,” as well as “Desperately Devoted,” which will stream with video for the first time beginning November 2.


“[Las Culturistas with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-las-culturistas-with-matt-31090140/) ” is executive produced by Will Ferrell and iHeartMedia and distributed by iHeartPodcasts. Listeners can continue to enjoy the podcast on the iHeartRadio app and everywhere podcasts are heard.


Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang are represented by UTA, 3 Arts, and SRDA.


Download the hi-res cover art[HERE](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/r7r5iyasb0vki1qmw8xi9/h/LasCulturistasV3-FINAL3000x3000.png?rlkey=d5qiscyprz97w93h25plt0ea3&st=0jxp4f6v&dl=0)


**About Matt Rogers**


Matt Rogers is an actor, comedian, writer, and recording artist known for his sharp wit and undeniable charm. He co-hosts the acclaimed podcast "Las Culturistas" with Bowen Yang, which has earned major recognition, including being named one of TIME’s “100 Best Podcasts of All Time” and winning “Podcast of the Year” at the iHeartRadio Podcast Awards. The duo also host the annual sold-out "Las Culturistas Culture Awards," an awards show broadcast since 2024 on Bravo and Peacock, which just celebrated its fifth year. In March 2026, they received the Stephen F. Kolzak Award at the GLAAD Media Awards for their impact in promoting LGBTQ+ visibility. Each December, Matt hits the road for his fan-favorite holiday tour, which this year will include stops across the U.S., Canada, and the U.K., earning him his “Prince of Christmas” moniker. He’ll hit the road again this year for the high-energy spectacle packed with tracks from the album and brand-new seasonal anthems. Behind the scenes, Rogers has written for "The Other Two" and "Q-Force," and co-created and hosted "Gayme Show." On screen, Rogers has appeared in the Netflix dark comedy "No Good Deed" alongside Lisa Kudrow and Ray Romano. He broke out in "I Love That For You," earning praise as a standout performer. Most recently, audiences can see him in "Stop! That! Train!" in a role which critics hailed as “hilarious.” Matt’s credits also include "Overcompensating," "Palm Royale," and the film "Good Fortune." He starred in the celebrated queer romantic comedy "Fire Island," which received multiple award nominations. Upcoming, Rogers will appear in Season 2 of Prime Video’s "Mr. and Mrs. Smith," directed by Donald Glover.


**About Bowen Yang**


Bowen Yang is a five-time Emmy®-nominated comedian, actor and writer who has captivated audiences with his distinct wit and comedic style while breaking barriers across film, television and podcasting. Most recently, Yang made his Broadway debut as Mary Todd Lincoln in Cole Escola’s must-see comedy, Oh, Mary! His Broadway run as Mary has now been extended through January 17, 2027. Yang is also a co-producer on the Céline Dion-inspired musical parody Titaníque which earned four 2026 Tony® Award nominations. Yang created memorable moments and characters throughout his seven seasons at SATURDAY NIGHT LIVE. He received four Emmy® Award nominations for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series, making him the most-nominated Asian male performer in Emmy® history; as well as an Emmy® nomination for Outstanding Writing for a Variety Series in 2019. Yang co-hosts the award-winning podcast, Las Culturistas, alongside Matt Rogers. Their 5th annual Las Culturistas Culture Awards premiered for its second televised installment on Bravo and Peacock on June 17. He starred in THE WEDDING BANQUET, Andrew Ahn’s remake of the 1993 comedy, as well as Universal Pictures’ Academy® award-nominated WICKED as “Pfannee”, reprising his role in WICKED: FOR GOOD. He will next lend his vocal talents as a voice in Warner Brothers’ animated film THE CAT IN THE HAT, releasing on November 6. Yang was honored with the Vantage Award at the 2025 Academy Museum Gala, and more recently, received the Stephen F. Kolzak Award alongside Matt at the 2026 GLAAD Media Awards.


**About Disney+**


Disney+ is the dedicated streaming home for movies and shows from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, and National Geographic, along with The Simpsons and outside the U.S., general entertainment brand Hulu. As the flagship direct-to-consumer streaming service from The Walt Disney Company, Disney+ serves as a connection point for audiences around the world with an unmatched collection of award-winning general entertainment, gold-standard family programming, the most trusted news, and global sports programming from ESPN. With unprecedented access to Disney’s long history of incredible film and television entertainment, it is also the exclusive streaming home for the newest releases from The Walt Disney Studios. Disney+ is available as a standalone streaming service or as part of bundle offerings in the U.S. whereby bundle subscribers can now stream Hulu and ESPN content directly in the Disney+ app. Subscriptions also include access to the Disney+ Perks loyalty program including special discounts, everyday savings, and early access to exclusive experiences that only Disney can offer. For more, visit[disneyplus.com](http://disneyplus.com/) , or find the Disney+ app on most mobile and connected TV devices.


**About Hulu**


Hulu is a leading premium on-demand and live streaming service in the U.S. that offers an expansive slate of entertainment from every major U.S. broadcast network as well as 20th Century Studios, ABC, ABC News, ESPN, FX, Searchlight Pictures, and many more. For more than 17 years, Hulu has provided on-demand access to hit TV series and films, award-winning Originals and exclusive licensed content. With Hulu + Live TV, subscribers receive a unique combination of 100+ live news, entertainment and sports TV channels and can access Hulu’s on-demand library, plus Disney+ and ESPN in their respective apps, all in one plan. Hulu is available as a standalone streaming service or as part of bundle offerings with different combinations of Disney+ and ESPN and can be further personalized through a variety of premium add-on subscriptions. Visit[hulu.com](http://hulu.com/) to subscribe or learn more about the service.


**About Big Money Players Podcast Network**


Founded by Will Ferrell and iHeartMedia, the[Big Money Players Network](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/category/big-money-players-218) is the premiere destination for comedy podcasts and home to top comedic talent across a variety of formats and styles – both scripted and unscripted. In addition to audio’s No. 1 comedy “The Ron Burgundy Podcast,” BMP features long-running hits like “Las Culturistas with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang,” “Thanks Dad with Ego Nwodim,” “Hollywood Handbook,” “StraightioLab” and more. All BMP podcasts are executive produced by Will Ferrell and iHeartMedia and are distributed by iHeartPodcasts.
